sql: SELECT id, title, status, desk, published_at FROM article;
SELECT id, kind, article, text FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull';
SELECT id, status, title, body FROM article WHERE status != 'c_04';
SELECT id, kind, article, text, created_at FROM brief WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7];
SELECT * FROM factbox WHERE article IN [article:a12, article:a19, article:a28, article:a33, article:a41, article:a5, article:a7];
SELECT id, title, body, status FROM article WHERE body CONTAINS 'kill' OR body CONTAINS 'pull' OR body CONTAINS 'retract' OR title CONTAINS 'kill' OR title CONTAINS 'pull';
